Check the washer is flat and centered and the link remains seated before proceeding to the next screw.

primaryWasherDrawing.availability: Drawing establishes dimensions only; source calls nonpreferred sizes potentially limited. Actual available stock unverified.

headBearingBoundary: Area is nominal geometric overlap, not washer bending/load/torque certification. Published head CAD does not inspect actual received screws. Use metal, not a printed shim.
newLowerLinkAlternative: Integral-seat lower links are validated for a new build. Replacing already assembled lower links would reopen captured ankle interfaces; no force-fit-preserving replacement sequence has been validated.
readiness: Conditional digital review only; not adopted as current main-guide default. Identify8 exact metal washers and confirm each original recess permits flat seating before execution. Strength and real screw/recess tolerances remain unverified.
